_doc: Stomp styles (docs/decisions/0061-stomp-lock.md): how a Hunter's stomp on an enemy wisp looks. Every style keeps the same timing (Stomp.TIME, Stomp.BEATS); only the body changes. A style lists what it changes from 'base'. 'hunter' marks a Hunter's own default (always owned); a style with 'cost' is a cosmetic you buy with gems and wear in the 'stomp' slot (Save.d.look.stomp). foot: r | l | both (a two-footed jump) | alt (right, then left) | none (both feet stay down; the knees give by crouch on each hit). lift and knee: hip and knee angles in radians at the top of the lift. hop: metres the body rises before the slam. lean: forward tilt in radians (lean_up: the tilt at the top of the lift, when it differs). twist: shoulder turn in radians at the top. crouch: 0..1 how low the standing leg sits. arms: out (left arm out for balance) | wide (both out) | up (both fists overhead, down with the slam) | fists (both fists hammer the ground) | hips (hands on hips) | cast (both palms come up and push down, magic) | weapon (the weapon stays in hand). swing: the weapon is swung (StompLook.weapon): top and hit are its pitch in radians at the top and on the slam (+ up, - down), yaw, reach (m from the chest to the grip), two (the left hand on the haft too). The wind-up is slow and the drop fast, but every hit lands on Stomp.SLAM like the feet.

thunder_stomp.name: Thunder Stomp
thunder_stomp.desc: A twisting leap and both feet down like a dropped anvil.
